description: Same direction/magnitude reassignment test as patch_reassignment_nnpatching_v1.json, run against scripts/checkpoint_eval/nnpatch.py's checkpoint-mode reconstruction (live features from the canonical backbone checkpoint) instead of the from-scratch training path.
rq: Mechanism: is NN-Patching's repair-vs-regression behaviour, used as the RQ2 mechanism contrast against DynaPatch, still direction-dominated once scored from checkpoints rather than freshly trained?
hypothesis: Same as patch_reassignment_nnpatching_v1: repair depends on the direction of the patch's logit change more than its magnitude.
falsifier: The median RR_held advantage of the original assignment over global reassignment is at most 0.02, or fewer than 24 of 36 cells exceed the null 97.5th percentile.
support_rule: Support if the median advantage is greater than 0.05 and at least 30 of 36 cells exceed the null 97.5th percentile.

data.population: Rows where the frozen base prediction is wrong. patched_logits/patch_pred_raw are NN-Patching's own raw patch-head output, UNCONDITIONAL on its own router. Seed 101 only -- NNPatch checkpoints only exist at seed 101 (artifacts/checkpoints/baselines/NNPatch/).

compute.device: CPU analysis from saved logits; invocation pins CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

stopping_rule: Sanity check only -- compare against patch_reassignment_nnpatching_v1's from-scratch numbers, do not treat as a replacement for it. Requires scripts/checkpoint_eval/nnpatch.py --per-sample outputs/checkpoint_eval_persample to have been run first for every (dataset, backbone).
